tools.name: where_to_watch
tools.description: Find where a football team's upcoming matches (or a specific match like 'Arsenal v Chelsea') are shown live in a given country, with the kickoff in local time, the licensed channel or stream, verified subscription prices where known, and a link to the full page. Covers the Premier League, La Liga, S

tools.name: matches
tools.description: List upcoming football matches (next 14 days), optionally filtered by date, competition, team or country, with kickoff in local time and the channel in that country.

tools.name: watch_competition
tools.description: Who holds the rights to a football competition in a country this season, the cheapest verified monthly price (each with source and date checked), and links to the country page and the price comparison. Prices are only returned when verified within the last 90 days.
